verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's pricing page lists a "Developer sandbox & sync" feature, so the product itself claims a sandbox environment. That claim is only a single line-item mention. Nothing describes how the sandbox is isolated from production data, how it is provisioned, or how API testing against it works. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox isolation from production data, provisioning and API endpoint details for sandbox testing, an explanation of what "sync" copies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
